item.title: Hong Kong gov’t condemns BBC over ‘unfounded report’ on Jimmy Lai’s health
item.description: The Hong Kong government has slammed the BBC over what it said was an “unfounded report” about pro-democracy media mogul Jimmy Lai’s health conditions while in prison. item.description: Hong Kong’s anti-corruption watchdog has announced the arrests of 21 people allegedly involved in manipulating two renovation project contracts at housing estates in Kwun Tong. item.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a 13-year-old girl for allegedly slapping and kicking another girl, 15, at Kwun Tong Promenade in the early hours of New Year’s Day.
